notes: The Momence hosts named in issue #298, each studio's locations read from its own site on 2026-09-11. Momence's public host record (https://momence.com/_api/primary/plugin/hosts/<id>) names host 35337 'Folk Yoga' and host 5610 'HAUM STUDIOS'; it lists no locations, so the addresses come from folksf.com/locations and haumstudios.com. Two fetches the same day agreed on every name and address. Hours are not taken: Richmond and both HAUM pages publish none, and the 20th St page's openingHoursSpecification names Monday three times, omits Tuesday and Thursday, and opens Sunday at '09:0:00'. The HAUM Mission page in the issue links the Haight-Ashbury page; its own page is /mission-studio. The issue's 94103 for 780 Stanyan is HAUM's 94117 on its own page. Each studio's referral offer lives in seed_pages.py REFERRALS under the page source id in extra.page_source_id.
